Usage: astryx theme add [options] [slug]

Add a built theme to the app. To copy a theme's source as an editable fork, run `theme eject <slug> [path] [--overwrite]`.

Options:
  --list               List available themes
  --import             Compatibility no-op; the built theme is added with or without this flag
  --package <package>  Select the package that owns the theme
  -h, --help           display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  the theme is listed or added
  1  the theme, its built imports, its record, or the option combination is invalid

Examples:
  # Add a built theme to the app
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add ocean
  # Select a package theme over a local theme
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add ocean --package @acme/themes

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/theme-add
